pkgmetadata.longdescription: Freesm Launcher is a fork of Prism Launcher that removes offline account restrictions, adds custom authentication server support (Ely.by, authlib-injector) while keeping Microsoft (licensed) login, plus extra theming and customization. Microsoft client ID and CurseForge API key are baked into the upstream CMakeLists by default, so source builds keep both licensed login and CurseForge mod downloads working.
